unsupported: Rainbow Energy Center, LLC (REC) acquired Coal Creek Station, a coal-fired power plant near Underwood, North Dakota, on May 1, 2022.
The acquisition included the plant's generation assets and approximately 200 employees.
The ownership structure places both entities under common leadership focused on efficient energy production and sound energy management.
The company operates Coal Creek Station as a baseload generation facility while also pursuing wind energy development and carbon capture initiatives.
Electricity from Coal Creek Station serves residential, commercial, and industrial customers across the region.
